# GNK ASG — Naming Rules

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

Keep article URLs, image names, video draft names and prepared public texts consistent, readable and useful.

## URL rules

Use lowercase ASCII slugs.

Format:

`/en/insights/yyyy/mm/topic-title/`

Examples:

- `/en/insights/2026/06/ai-corporate-portal-understanding/`
- `/en/insights/2026/06/corporate-transparency-public-data/`
- `/en/insights/2026/06/gnk-dinamo-ltd-public-framework/`

## Image file rules

Use descriptive names.

Format:

`topic-entity-year-month-day.png`

Examples:

- `gnk-asg-ai-corporate-portal-2026-06-01.png`
- `gnk-asg-corporate-transparency-2026-06-02.png`
- `gnk-dinamo-ltd-public-framework-2026-06-03.png`

## Video package names

Format:

`weekly-brief-yyyy-week-topic`

Examples:

- `weekly-brief-2026-w23-ai-public-data`
- `weekly-brief-2026-w24-corporate-transparency`

## Title rules

Good titles are specific, professional and not exaggerated.

Avoid:

- clickbait
- shouting
- too many repeated names
- unsupported claims
- overlong titles

## Byline rules

Use accurate labels:

- Prepared by GNK ASG Intelligence Desk
- Approved by director, only after approval
- Author, only after express confirmation

## Homepage rule

The homepage should not carry excessive personal naming. Use corporate naming first and internal pages for stronger profile context.
